svg.text: NEXT-GEN AI ETHERNET: NVIDIA SPECTRUM-X & ULTRA ETHERNET (UEC) PACKET SPRAYING & OOO
Adaptive Packet Spraying + SuperNIC Out-of-Order Direct Placement Hits 96.2% Multi-Tenant busbw
2,048-GPU 400G Multi-Tenant Cluster: Tier 1 Legacy RoCEv2 (26.8 GB/s, 53.6% Eff.) vs. Tier 4 Spectrum-X / UEC (48.1 GB/s, 96.2% Eff.)
⛔ Tier 1 & 3 Traps: In-Order GBN & Spray Mismatch
1. Why Legacy RoCEv2 Can Only Reach ~53.6% in Multi-Tenant:
• Traditional RNICs require strict in-order packets (`PSN`);
switches must pin each 400G QP flow to 1 Spine link via ECMP!
2. Fatal Trap (Tier 3): Turning On Switch Spraying Without NIC `OOO`:
• If Spine switches spray packets across links while the RNIC
is in strict in-order mode, every out-of-order packet triggers
`Go-Back-N` NAK storms—collapsing `busbw` to `14.2 GB/s`!
3. Flowlet DLB Limitation on Continuous RDMA Streams:
• Line-rate RDMA lacks `>50us` inter-packet gaps to switch paths
Tier 1 Legacy RoCEv2 Multi-Tenant Failure (2,048 GPUs):
• Multi-Tenant Effective `busbw`: 26.8 GB/s (Only 53.6% line rate)
• P99 MoE All-to-All Tail Latency: 28.4 ms
• Monthly 2,048-GPU Network Stall TCO: $940,000 / month
🏆 Tier 4: Spectrum-X & UEC (Packet Spray + SuperNIC OOO)
1. Switch Adaptive Packet Spraying (`ARS` Across All Spines):
• Spectrum-4 / Tomahawk 5 sprays every single RDMA packet onto
the least-loaded Spine port (`96.2%` link balance, zero collisions!)
2. SuperNIC Out-of-Order Direct Data Placement (`OOO DDP`):
• `BlueField-3 / ConnectX-8 / Thor 2` writes out-of-order packets
directly into exact GPU HBM offsets via PSN bitmap tracking!
3. Hardware Telemetry & Receiver-Driven CC (`RTT CC / UEC EQDS`):
• Sub-RTT congestion pacing eliminates MoE All-to-All Incast drops
Tier 4 Verified Production Benchmarks (2,048 GPUs):
• Multi-Tenant Effective `busbw`: 48.1 GB/s (96.2% of 50 GB/s!)
• P99 MoE All-to-All Tail Latency: 4.2 ms (-6.76x faster!)
• Monthly Stall TCO: $175,000 / mo (-81.4% savings vs. Tier 1)
